title: "I'm fully who I am": Towards Centering Transgender and Non-Binary Voices to Measure Biases in Open Language Generation
reasoning: The paper directly addresses ethical concerns by focusing on experienced and documented gender minoritization and marginalization within Large Language Models (LLMs). It aims to measure and mitigate gender biases and harms for transgender and non-binary individuals, advocating for gender-inclusive AI and Responsible ML and AI Fairness. This goes beyond a brief mention of ethics, making it a core component of the paper's evaluation framework.
